items.q: Is this safe? Will LinkedIn penalize me?
items.a: Yes, it's safe. You sign in through LinkedIn's official OAuth, you choose what to engage with, and you write your own comments. Nothing acts on your behalf, so you stay within LinkedIn's Terms of Service.

items.q: How is this different from automation or spam?
items.a: You stay in control at all times. We surface relevant posts and make engaging fast, but every action needs your intent. No bots, no bulk actions, no auto-posting.

items.q: What does the free trial include, and when am I charged?
items.a: You get the full experience. A card is required to start, but you are not charged until you've had 50 interactions (made or received) or 7 days pass, whichever comes first. Cancel anytime before then and you pay nothing.

items.q: What is SSI, and how fast will it move?
items.a: Your Social Selling Index is LinkedIn's 0–100 score across four areas: professional brand, the right people, insights and relationships. LinkedIn recalculates it daily. We don't read or predict that score and we don't promise a timeline. What we give you is a feed where real engagement is easy and a recap of every interaction you make and receive. Since August 2026 the SSI page is a Sales Navigator feature; free and Premium members no longer see it.

items.q: Do I need to be active every day?
items.a: No. Small, regular interactions are what move your SSI.
Yes. No contracts, no lock-in, no cancellation fees. Cancel from your subscription page whenever you like; access lasts until the end of the current period.
